methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen corded and cordless angle grinders spanning entry-level to professional tiers. Specs re-verified 2026-06-20 against manufacturer product pages (DeWalt, Makita, Milwaukee, Bosch, Metabo HPT, Ridgid, Ryobi) and reputable retailers (Coastal Tool, Tool Nut, Ohio Power Tool, CPO, Home Depot, Lowe's, Shell Lumber, Jackson's Hardware, KBC Tools). Booleans (brushless, no_volt_release) are true only when confirmed in product documentation; false when product pages/manuals indicate brushed motors or absence of the feature; null when not documented. Weights are tool-only unless noted; the Makita XAG04Z figure is the only published weight (with battery) and is annotated as such. Prices are current US retail MSRP or closest verified published USD price. Adversarial corrections made: DCG413B price 249->199 (Home Depot/Lowe's standard retail, not CPO premium); DWE43144N price 231->188 (Home Depot mainstream retail); Ridgid R86040B corrected from brushless to BRUSHED (X4 series is brushed; name and source corrected, was mislabeled via iFixit device title); Ryobi P421 switch corrected paddle->trigger (documented trigger switch). accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: DeWalt DWE402 4-1/2 in. Small Angle Grinder
products.priceNote: Typical current retail; no published MSRP on dewalt.com
products.provenance: Disc size 4.5 in, 11 A motor, 11,000 RPM, paddle switch with lock-off confirmed on DeWalt product page and Lowe's. Brushed motor (brushless false). Weight 4.6 lbs (tool only) confirmed by multiple retailer spec sheets. No-volt release not documented.

products.name: DeWalt DCG413B 20V MAX XR Brushless 4-1/2 in. Paddle Switch Angle Grinder (Tool Only)
products.priceNote: Current retail at Home Depot/Lowe's (tool only); DeWalt.com does not display MSRP
products.provenance: Brushless motor, paddle switch, kickback brake / E-Switch no-volt release, and 3-3/4 lb weight confirmed on DeWalt product page. 9,000 RPM confirmed across DeWalt, Lowe's, Home Depot. Price corrected 249->199: Home Depot and Lowe's list the tool-only at $199 (mainstream retail), not the $249 CPO premium listing in the draft.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 2880-20 4-1/2 in./5 in. Grinder Paddle Switch No-Lock (Tool Only)
products.priceNote: Current MSRP (Milwaukee / Ohio Power Tool); street price as low as $119 on promo
products.provenance: POWERSTATE brushless motor, paddle no-lock switch, 8,500 RPM, 5 in disc, and RAPIDSTOP brake confirmed on Milwaukee product page. Weight 3.1 lbs (tool only) per Ohio Power Tool. MSRP $229 confirmed; no-volt release not documented.

products.name: Makita GA4530 4-1/2 in. Corded Angle Grinder
products.provenance: 6 A, 11,000 RPM, slide switch with lock-on, 4.0 lbs confirmed on Makita product page and corroborated by ToolNut and ToolUp. Brushed motor (brushless false). No-volt release not documented.

products.name: Makita XAG04Z 18V LXT Brushless 4-1/2 in./5 in. Cut-Off/Angle Grinder (Tool Only)
products.provenance: BL brushless motor, slide switch with lock-on, anti-restart no-volt release, 8,500 RPM, 5 in max disc confirmed on Makita product page and ToolNut. Price $179 confirmed at ToolNut. Weight: 5.6 lb is the only published Makita figure and is measured WITH battery (no bare-tool weight is published); annotated rather than guessed.

products.name: Bosch GWS13-50 5 in. Corded Angle Grinder
products.provenance: 13 A, 11,500 RPM, 5.3 lbs, restart protection (no-volt release) confirmed on Bosch product page and Coastal Tool. Base GWS13-50 (060179G012) is the slide-switch model; the paddle variant is the separate GWS13-50PD, so slide switch is correct here. Price $159 confirmed at Coastal Tool.

products.name: Metabo HPT G12SR4 4-1/2 in. 6.2 A Slide Switch Corded Angle Grinder
products.priceNote: Published price at Shell Lumber ($74.25); widely available at Amazon/Lowe's for ~$29-39 as the G12SR4M kit
products.provenance: 6.2 A, 10,000 RPM, left-mounted slide switch, 4.0 lbs confirmed on Metabo HPT page and Shell Lumber ($74.25 list). Brushed motor (brushless false). No-volt release not documented. Note the more common street price is ~$29-39 (Amazon/Lowe's), but $74.25 is a real published retailer price.

products.name: Ryobi P421 18V ONE+ 4-1/2 in. Cordless Angle Grinder (Tool Only)
products.priceNote: Approximate current retail; discontinued, often found ~$29.99 (factory blemished) at Direct Tools Outlet
products.provenance: 4.5 in disc, 18V, 6,500 RPM, 4.8 lbs confirmed across Ryobi page and Amazon. Switch corrected paddle->trigger: documented as an underside trigger switch with top lock-off (Vehicle Service Pros / retailer specs), not a paddle. Brushed motor (brushless false). Listed discontinued on Ryobi.com.

products.name: Milwaukee 6130-33 7.0 A 4-1/2 in. Small Angle Grinder
products.provenance: 7 A, 3.5 lbs, sliding lock-on switch confirmed across Milwaukee page, Home Depot, Ohio Power Tool. 12,000 RPM confirmed by the majority of distributor spec sheets (Jackson's Hardware, Linde, ActionIS, Hardware Store); a minority list 11,000. Brushed motor (replaceable brushes). No-volt release not documented. Price $89 confirmed at ToolNut/Ohio Power Tool.

products.name: Bosch 1375A 4-1/2 in. 6 A Corded Angle Grinder
products.provenance: 6 A, 11,000 RPM, 3.75 lbs, slide (lock-on/off) switch confirmed across KBC Tools, Coastal Tool, and multiple distributor spec sheets. Brushed motor (ServiceMinder brushes). No current Bosch US page for this older model; specs confirmed via independent distributors. Price $97.89 from KBC Tools.

products.name: Ridgid R86040B 18V X4 4-1/2 in. Cordless Angle Grinder (Tool Only)
products.priceNote: Historical MSRP at Home Depot (tool only); discontinued/superseded
products.provenance: CORRECTED: this is the older X4 series, which is a BRUSHED motor, not brushless. The draft's 'brushless: true' and the 'Brushless' in the name were a fabrication propagated from an incorrectly titled iFixit device page ('Ridgid Brushless R86040'); Home Depot's official R86040B listing and retailer specs confirm the X4 grinder is brushed. brushless set false, name/source corrected. 9,000 RPM and 18V confirmed in the official Ridgid R86040 operator's manual. Slide switch and 4.5 lb weight per retailer specs. No-volt release not documented.

products.name: DeWalt DWE43144N 6 in. 13 A E-Clutch Paddle Switch Corded Angle Grinder (No Lock-On)
products.priceNote: Current retail at Home Depot ($188); ToolNut lists higher (~$231)
products.provenance: 13 A, 9,000 RPM, paddle switch (no lock-on), E-Clutch, and Power-Off overload/restart protection (no-volt release) confirmed on DeWalt page, Home Depot, and Amazon. 6 in disc and 6.2 lb weight confirmed. Brushed motor (brushless false). Price corrected 231->188 to the mainstream Home Depot retail price (ToolNut's $230.99 is a higher boutique listing).
